summary: Portfolio project is well-structured with solid Clean Architecture layering, passing tests (16/16), and proper separation of concerns. However, dependency vulnerabilities present a near-term risk—five high-severity and four moderate packages need updates. N+1 query patterns in the data layer and dual authentication strategies should be consolidated. Architecture and code quality are strong; focus on dependency patching and database query optimization.

topActions: Update 5 high-severity NuGet packages immediately (Microsoft.OpenApi, System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs, SSH.NET, MessagePack, WebAssembly.Server) to eliminate the largest security risk.
Consolidate N+1 in GetJob() by combining Job, Title, Skill queries into a single batch or using joins. Reduces latency by ~67% for single-job reads.
Clarify and enforce a single authentication strategy (API Key or JWT), remove the unused one, and add explicit CORS policy to WebApi. Tightens security posture.
nextSteps: Priority 1 (This week): Update all 5 high-severity packages and re-run tests
Priority 2 (This sprint): Optimize GetJob() query and add column-index caching in SqlDataReader loops
Priority 3 (Next sprint): Add code coverage measurement to CI pipeline and establish 75%+ target for core layers
Priority 4 (Backlog): Implement Central Package Management (Directory.Packages.props) to reduce dependency drift
